_about: Interop test vectors. Both Go and Swift cores MUST pass these. RFC vectors are external ground truth (expected codes from the RFC, secrets given as ASCII whose UTF-8 bytes are the raw key). steam/argon2id/vault sections are generated by the Go core and independently cross-verified, then pinned; Swift must match.

totp_rfc6238._note: secret_ascii UTF-8 bytes are the raw key; digits 8. times in unix seconds.

base32._note: RFC 4648 base32; decode is case-insensitive, padding optional, whitespace and '-' stripped, and strict about meaning: decode_reject inputs MUST be errors in both cores (empty, length 1/3/6 mod 8, non-canonical trailing bits, bad character).

decode_reject.why: empty after stripping padding and dashes
non-canonical trailing bits: re-encodes to MY
non-canonical trailing bits: re-encodes to MZXW6

parse._note: label encoding: %3A inside a component is data, the bare ':' is the separator. Split the ENCODED label on the first ':', then decode each side once.
query encoding: '+' in a query value is a space, so this issuer param agrees with the %20 label. Emitters write %20; parsers accept both.
query encoding: a literal plus is %2B and survives the '+'-as-space rule. In the label (a path component) '+' is already a literal plus.

migration._note: Canonical alexbakker example. Decodes to one TOTP account; secret raw bytes are 'Hello!'+0xdeadbeef whose base32 is JBSWY3DPEHPK3PXP.

steam._status: PINNED: generated by go/internal/vectorgen from the documented Steam algorithm; Swift must match.

argon2id._status: PINNED: generated by go/internal/vectorgen via x/crypto/argon2 IDKey; Swift swift-sodium must match.

hchacha20._status: PINNED: HChaCha20 KAT (draft-irtf-cfrg-xchacha 2.2.1), computed via x/crypto/chacha20.HChaCha20. Swift HChaCha20 must produce subkey_b64.

aead_payload._status: PINNED: XChaCha20-Poly1305 with a FIXED DEK and nonce (no argon2id). Swift must Open this to expected_canonical_json byte-for-byte. Verifies HChaCha20 + ChaChaPoly + canonical-JSON decode locally.

vault_crossdecrypt._status: PINNED: Go-encrypted with the passphrase below; Swift MUST decrypt the envelope to expected_canonical_json (byte-for-byte). Negatives MUST be rejected.

negatives._note: wrong_passphrase MUST fail; tamper any payload.ct byte and decryption MUST fail; base64url-encoded fields MUST be rejected by a strict std-base64 decoder.

handles._status: Deterministic handle assignment + canonical serialization. Both cores MUST produce identical handles and identical canonical bytes.

envelope_strict._note: error classes: corrupt (malformed, duplicate, non-canonical or out-of-bounds input), auth_failed (no passphrase wrap or payload authenticates), no_wraps, too_many_wraps, unsupported_version, unsupported_aead, app_only (secure-enclave wraps only), no_passphrase_wrap (no passphrase or secure-enclave wrap)
